title: Reconstruct a 2-Row Binary Matrix
description: Reconstruct a 2xN binary matrix given the sum of each row and an array of column sums.
pseudocode:
1. initialize res = [[0]*n, [0]*n]
2. for i in range(n):
3.   if colSum[i] == 2: res[0][i] = 1, res[1][i] = 1, upper--, lower--
4.   elif colSum[i] == 1:
5.     if upper >= lower: res[0][i] = 1, upper--
6.     else: res[1][i] = 1, lower--
7. if upper != 0 or lower != 0: return []
8. return res

steps.note: colSum[0] is 1, upper(1) >= lower(1), assign to row 0
colSum[1] is 1, upper(0) < lower(1), assign to row 1
colSum[2] is 1, upper(0) < lower(0), assign to row 1
